what.text: This page follows refugees from Nigeria living in Niger.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 258359 Nigerian refugees in Niger, 54.0% of all Nigerian refugees and more than in any other host country.
Cameroon hosts the next largest number.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Nigeria with JAS in 2009 and from 2011 to 2025, at war level from 2013 to 2015 and in 2017.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2025, at war level in most of those years.

when.text: UNHCR's figure for Niger rose from 6 in 1996 to 258359 in 2025, its highest.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2025, after big changes in each year from 2013 to 2016.
Returns from Niger to Nigeria were highest in 2023 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in Niger only.
Gender and age are known for only part of this group.
The sources don't say which routes people took or where in Niger they live.
